description: Kontainer connects ChatGPT to your organization’s DAM and PIM workspace. Find and inspect images, videos, and documents; organize folders and collections; manage asset metadata and CDN delivery; maintain product records and channel data; administer workspace users and permissions; and review usage statistics. Actions run within the authenticated Kontainer tenant and follow the user’s Kontainer permissions.

defaultPrompt: Find the latest campaign images and summarize their usage rights.
Show incomplete products and list the fields that still need values.
Review download activity and identify the most-used assets.
